recipes.name: Easy Breezy Casserole
ingredients_raw: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cooked and cubed
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium bowl combine the chicken, soup, mayonnaise and macaroni; mix well and spread mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 35 to 45 minutes, or until cooked through.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Breezy Casserole
raw_recipe.description: Only 4 ingredients - chicken breast, creamy soup, mayonnaise and macaroni - and you have a cooked casserole dinner on your hands!

review.reviewBody:
The Whole Family loved it,Wife couldn't believe how good it was and both of my kids had seconds. Did make some changes after reading up on some other users reviews 1. Used the sour cream instead of the mayo 2. Added Broccoli 3. I also added 1 can of cream of celery. To finish shreeded on a bit of cheddar cheese. 

P.S. 1 cup of noodles was not enough

I had some chicken breast w/ peppers and onion frozen. I cooked the 1/2 box of elbow noodles . Meanwhile in a frying pan w 1 tbs butter,cooked the frozen chicken ,peppers,and onion on low heat with I stalk broccoli crowns in smaller pieces covered. Cubed up chicken breast ,back into pan. Drained noodles and added into same frying pan. Added the sour cream and 2 cans cream chicken soup ,and about 1/2 cup milk to thin out sauce a little . Stir and simmer on low till all ingredients blend together. Simmer on low. Since all ingredients are cooked already you are done. Add some shredded cheese on top and let melt on top if desired.

only gave it 4 stars cause I tweaked it. Used 1 can cream of chicken, 1 can cream of broccoli and 1 can cream of mushroom. Seasoned chicken breast with salt free chicken grill mate seasoning, pepper and freeze dried basil - eyed it - used quite a bit of each - sauted chicken in butter and 1/2 tbsp minced garlic w/ juice from the jar. used 1 bag shredded reduced fat mild cheddar - mixed 3/4 in with casserole, put 1/4 on top. Used whole bag of frozen broccoli, cooked. Husband and I were pleasantly surprised - casserole's with this much cream of XX soups usually are to heavy and sit funny in our tummies - this, though, tasted great and was very satisfying. Will definitely be our go to casserole when we need something for leftovers!

My hubby and myself loved this casserole. I tweaked a bit by using noodles and more than a cupful. Also added 1/2 can Campbells Chicken broth to the soup & mayo mix. Added frozen sweet peas also and for chicken I shredded some leftover rotisserie chicken to the mix. For topping I crushed about 15 ritz crackers in a ziploc bag & added 1/4 cup grated Parmesan. I sprinkled it on top of casserole and baked it. It was delicious. Used leftovers as frozen TV dinners. Thanx for sharing

I made some changes to this receipe, because of the reviews I didn't want it to be blah. I seasoned the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic salt and italian seasoning. I added alot more macaroni. 1 chopped onion sauted in olive oil, 1 eight ounce can of mushrooms sauted in butter.I put 1/4 cup manonnaise and 1/4 cup sour cream. I Topped casserole with crispy fried onions and popped in the oven, Once cooked I topped with a mixture of cheeces (montery jack and sharp cheedar) turned out very well easy dish.

Five stars for a great starting point for chicken noodle casserole. I added 1 can of condensed cream of mushroom soup. One jar 12 oz. turkey gravy. I used 18oz. Of egg noodles and increased the mayo to 1 cup, using 4 large boneless chicken breasts. I also mixed in one can of peas. Yes, for all those who are saying I changed the recipe entirely.. Yes I did. You see, I didn't have a starting point when I ran across this one and I had to make a meal out of the chicken breast I had out thawing already and had no clue what to do with it. So this recipe ( the posters) gave me just the start I needed so hands down a 5 star rating! Thank you!

This is a good recipe if you want to stretch a dollar. I only had 2 large chicken breasts and had to make a dinner for 4. There was plenty casserole, plus enough for my husband to take lunch tomorrow. I made the following changes: First, I cut the raw chicken into chunks, seasoned with poultry seasoning and garlic salt, then sauteed in butter and olive oil. I used 1/2 cup sour cream 1/2 cup mayo mixture. Added about a cup of shredded swiss cheese, and two cups of cooked broccoli. And I increased the amount of noodles (I cooked 1 1/2 cup raw). I would definitely recommend adding more noodles, it was my kids favorite part and we could have used more. Finally, I topped with crushed ritz crackers. Not bad...

I didn't have the condensed cream of chicken soup. So I used can of cream of mushroom soup instead. I added 4 oz. can mushrooms to it, also a 15 oz. can of can of sweet peas. I added one cup of chicken broth to the bowl and one tablespoon of basil. My family loved it.

This was a great base recipe. I used Canola oil and added Lawry's seasoned salt, garlic powder, minced onion, sage, and parsley to the cubed chicken. That sure got rid of the bland taste. I boiled fresh brocoli with the pasta. I used mini shells instead of elbow. I combined a can of cream of chicken and cream of brocoli soup with Miracle whip. After I combined the chicken with the soups I cubed up velvetta and added it to the mixture. Spreaded it into a 9x13 pan and cooked it at 375 degrees. It melted the cheese very nicely and gave it a thicker texture. There was no leftovers!!!!! Will make again for sure. Thanks.

Delicious!! I used a leftover rotisserie chicken from the grocery store, mixed in 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese, and sprinkled the top with plain bread crumbs. I don't know why someone said this had no flavor- it was great, esp. for such an easy dinner! Note: I tried this recipe again, but used cream of broccoli soup and chunks of steamed broccoli along with cheese- it was delicious!

My family really liked this recipe! I was actually surprised by how much I liked it. I chose it because it was simple and these days I need simple. I made very few changes. First, I doubled the recipe. Next, due to cost, I used chicken thighs rather than chicken breasts. I also seasoned the chicken with garlic salt and pepper while it was cooking. I used 98% fat free soup and lite mayo. Baked it for 40 minutes, then topped with reduced fat cheese. It was very yummy, and resulted in no leftovers.
Been making this for years. We add Parmesan cheese on top at the table. The Parmesan cheese makes this so much better.
Will definitely make this dish again, added seasoning &topped with cheese....DELICIOUS!!!!!!!

This is a great base recipe for beginners, and easily allows for substitutions and additions. I made it with a group of 9 & 10 year old girls for our church "Activity Days" (they each made their own to take home and serve their family) They had a great time and their mommies were happy not to have to make dinner that night.
It needs a little more seasonings and I doubled it to serve a family, plus at least double the macaroni in the original.

My kids Loved it!! I did tweak it a bit, I added a jar of alfredo sauce along with a handful of fresh grated parmesan cheese to amp it up, my kids eat a lot and there are 5 people in my family. I tossed sliced fresh broccoli n baby carrots to the pasta right before the pasta was done. It was getting late so I used packaged cooked chicken strips. Super good n Fast!! So sorry Gloria that its taken SO LONG to give this yummy dinner a face:) Keeper!! MMMMMMMM
great foundation be creative after that
Good basic recipe. I added grated cheese and garlic sautéed mushrooms to the mix and added even more cheese to the top for more interesting flavour.

This was a hit with my family. I wish I would of read some of the other reviews. I did put some cheese on the top for the last 10 minutes. I sprinkled some Lawry's garlic salt with parsley on it and it was great. Next time I will use it on the chicken when I cook it and add some canned mushrooms to it too. I also used the 3 minute macaroni and that sped up the prep time too.
I did not care for this recipe- too bland - I was embarrassed serving it. Won't make that again.

Pretty basic and easy to dash up to your own liking. While I cooked my chicken I added seasoned salt and pepper on it. I also used rice instead of macaroni, since I didnt have any macaroni. Next I added canned veggies of my liking and one chicken boullin cube that I melted in 1/2 cup of water to add some more flavor to the mix. Topped it with some crushed crackers and mozzarella cheese
